name: v18.18.6
body:
## @oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

### Fixed

- LiteLLM lists only the models the configured key can call (its authenticated `/v1/models`), keeping the proxy's metadata for them; a proxy whose `/v1/models` fails now lists no models instead of every model it serves ([#18601](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/18601))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

### Added

- In Tern, a turn's long-press menu on a phone can edit and resend a prompt, retry the turn, open the rewind page on it, or fork the session from it into a new session
- A rewind from the transcript says how many turns it dropped and offers Undo on its toast in Tern, which puts the turns and your draft back

### Changed

- Browser `role/` selectors in Chrome tabs now match the role and name Chrome's accessibility tree reports, so they reach open shadow roots and skip hidden elements; in Tern every name `observe()` reports selects its element again ([#18632](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18632) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))

### Fixed

- A late usage-limit error from a previous provider no longer blocks or cools down the selected provider; when the old provider has spent its retry budget, a replay-safe turn still tries the selected model without the old quota delay ([#17098](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/17098), [#17571](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17571) by [@Bensonluo](https://github.com/Bensonluo))
- Multi-question ask forms in Tern show Submit on the last question tab, not only on the Review tab
- MCP `headers` and stdio `env` values that use `!command` now run again on a 401/403 (the request is retried once), on `/mcp reconnect` and other reconnects, and on `/mcp reload`, so servers whose command mints short-lived tokens keep working past expiry instead of staying 401 until restart ([#18631](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/18631))
- Pausing an unapproved plan no longer tells the agent that the draft was approved or to continue executing it, and pausing with `/plan` closes an open plan review so it can no longer save and execute the plan ([#18610](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/18610)).
- Turning off `lsp.enabled` now also stops `write` and `edit` from starting language servers for diagnostics or formatting; previously only the `lsp` tool was disabled ([#18205](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/18205), [#18490](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18490) by [@yuzu-octopus](https://github.com/yuzu-octopus))
- Fixed background tabs omp borrows (relay `app.target`, `app.cdp_url`) ignoring omp's clicks and keys or timing out on hover and drag; the page reads as visible while omp drives it and hidden again once released ([#17831](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17831) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed the transcript jumping at the screen's top edge while scrolled back during a streamed reply, and the screen dropping two rows when a reply finished ([#12307](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/12307), [#16117](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16117) by [@galtamam-cmyk](https://github.com/galtamam-cmyk))
- Focusing a subagent or returning to the main session no longer loses or freezes the next assistant reply when a fast tool turn finishes before the previous reply's links finish resolving, and messages and tool runs that arrive during the switch show exactly once, in order ([#18564](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18564) by [@eggpeat](https://github.com/eggpeat))
- `omp gc --strip` now keeps every response of the latest replay turn (including earlier tool-call steps joined by their tool results), reference-only images, and the transcript's file permissions ([#18636](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18636) by [@eggpeat](https://github.com/eggpeat))
- Session files whose entries were written without ids are re-indexed when loaded, and migrating old sessions no longer gives two entries the same id ([#18636](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18636) by [@eggpeat](https://github.com/eggpeat))
- `wait` and `write proc://<id>/kill` now say how a settled job's result reached the caller: delivered by the call itself (it finished while the call ran), handed over by this snapshot (it superseded the job's queued completion push, so no duplicate follows), or genuinely late — the last keeps its "not auto-delivered; recovered by this snapshot" warning and adds how long before the call it had finished ([#16052](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/16052), [#18635](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18635) by [@yuzu-octopus](https://github.com/yuzu-octopus))
- Fixed `ask` notes added with `n` right after picking an answer landing on the previous question instead of the one shown; a Tern click then Note still notes the answer just clicked, and the Note button names it ([#18317](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18317) by [@DonMikone](https://github.com/DonMikone))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-natives

### Fixed

- Fixed GTK4 apps such as Files (Nautilus) on X11: element clicks and `computer.elementAt()` now find their elements where they are on screen, and `ax()` no longer marks their enabled controls `(disabled)` ([#18643](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18643) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- `grep` no longer searches the file its own output is redirected into, nor standard input redirected from that same file: both are refused with `input file is also the output`, as GNU grep does ([#14808](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/14808), [#16489](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16489) by [@yuzu-octopus](https://github.com/yuzu-octopus))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-tui

### Added

- The `wait` result's `JobSnapshot` now carries `settledAtMs` (epoch ms when the run settled, absent while it is still running), so a snapshot can tell a result that finished during the call from one recovered from an earlier, never-delivered completion ([#18635](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18635) by [@yuzu-octopus](https://github.com/yuzu-octopus))
- Added a `thinking.set` composer action so Tern's phone effort menu can pick a thinking level in one tap
- Added All, Running, Done and Parked status scopes with counts to the agent hub's roster, so Tern's phone can filter agents by status
- A prompt and a turn's answer list their actions for a phone's long press (`actions.hold`): Copy, Edit & resend (a prompt's), Retry turn, Rewind to here… and Fork from here; the desktop keeps its hover toolbars
- A click or tap on a turn on the native rewind page picks it, and the rewind selector can open on a given turn (`startAt`)
- A status notice can carry a button on its native toast (`StatusNoticeAction`), such as the Undo after a rewind

### Fixed

- Fixed streamed rows being clipped above the screen before they reached scrollback while the working row was up, so a scrolled-back terminal saw rows jump at the screen's top edge and the whole screen dropped when a run ended ([#12307](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/12307), [#16117](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16117) by [@galtamam-cmyk](https://github.com/galtamam-cmyk)). `Composer.setRuntimeChildren` takes a `billedChrome` option for roots billed at their current height instead of through the floor.
- Fixed rows of a streaming reply, and the top rows of a table taller than the screen, going missing from both the screen and scrollback with `tui.completeScrollback` on; such a table now keeps the column widths it had when it outgrew the screen ([#16355](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16355) by [@galtamam-cmyk](https://github.com/galtamam-cmyk))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-wire

### Added

- `actions.hold` (`TspMenuEntry[]`): what a long press on a touch screen offers, beside `actions.menu`; and `toast`'s `action` / `label` props for a button on the toast


## What's Changed
* fix(coding-agent): keep late quota errors off the fallback provider by @Bensonluo in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17571
* fix(builtins): refuse to grep the file grep writes its output to by @yuzu-octopus in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16489
* fix(mcp): re-ran command-backed headers on 401 and reconnect by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18633
* fix(plan): prevent unapproved drafts from becoming execution references by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18615
* fix(catalog): scoped litellm discovery to virtual keys by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18602
* fix(coding-agent): gate write/edit LSP writethrough on lsp.enabled by @yuzu-octopus in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18490
* test(natives): unset LIBEI_SOCKET under the env lock in the Wayland no-portal test by @will-bogusz in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18649
* fix(coding-agent): resolve Chromium role selectors through Chrome's accessibility tree by @will-bogusz in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18632
* fix(coding-agent): let background relay and app.cdp_url tabs take omp's clicks and keys by @will-bogusz in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17831
* fix(tui): completeScrollback commits a streaming reply's rows, tall tables included, as they leave the screen by @galtamam-cmyk in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16355
* fix(tui): commit streamed rows as they leave the screen while the working row is up by @galtamam-cmyk in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16117
* fix(tui): serialize live events after focus attachment by @eggpeat in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18564
* fix(coding-agent): preserve the latest replay turn during gc stripping by @eggpeat in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18636
* fix(coding-agent): label a wait-delivered result accurately (#16052) by @yuzu-octopus in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18635
* fix(natives): find GTK4 app elements on X11 and stop marking them disabled by @will-bogusz in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18643

* @Bensonluo made their first contribution in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17571
